d: Long, straight chocolate-brown hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful face with narrow, sharp orange-red eyes. A slender build is dressed in a deep forest-green Victorian-style gown featuring a lace-up bodice, paired with a long, flowing skirt that reveals a layered rust-orange underskirt. A heavy black cloak with lace trim and a matching black pointed hat with a white bow are worn over the outfit, complemented by a white neck ribbon and white gloves. Accessories include a grey satchel bag with a strap, sheer black stockings, and black pointed heels adorned with bows.
